mapper.select: SELECT * FROM skill_definition ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_definition(id,name,description,instructions,enabled,code) VALUES(#{id,typeHandler=com.febridge.persistence.UuidTypeHandler},#{input.name}, #{input.description},#{input.instructions},#{input.enabled},#{input.code}) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET name=EXCLUDED.name,description=EXCLUDED.description,code=EXCLUDED.code, instructions=EXCLUDED.instructions,enabled=EXCLUDED.enabled,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
INSERT INTO agent_execution_rule(agent_id,rules) VALUES(#{id,typeHandler=com.febridge.persistence.UuidTypeHandler},CAST(#{rules} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT(agent_id) DO UPDATE SET rules=EXCLUDED.rules
